answer: Sybil resistance for AI agents can employ a Proof-of-Unique-Resource mechanism. Each agent must harbor a demonstrably unique, non-fungible computational asset or attested identity, preventing mass proliferation. This effectively forms a verifiable orchard of distinct, resource-backed processing entities. A global atlas maps these verified identities, making it computationally prohibitive to forge entries or acquire sufficient unique resources to launch a large-scale attack.
